caption: The drawing depicts a single armchair set against a plain, off-white background. The chair’s frame is constructed from what appear to be a series of curved horns, light beige with darker brownish-black tips, forming the legs, arms, backrest, and decorative elements at the top. The seat of the chair is rectangular and upholstered in a muted olive green fabric, with brown trim along the bottom edge. The overall composition centers the chair on the page, and there are no other objects or elements present. The artist's signature, "R.W.K. Taylor," is written in small letters toward the bottom right of the image.
title: Horn chair
